text:
anna: Heads up — seeing head-of-line blocking in prod fleet starting ~08:12 UTC. GPUs in us-west are idling behind a stalled gang job. admission queue length spiked, tail latency up.

mike: :eyes: can you paste the admission logs? which scheduler version?

anna: scheduler v2.3.1. logs show repeated AdmitRequest for job-id=job_1423 failing ~50x with 'insufficient resources' while smaller jobs later get scheduled.

jasper: that sounds like a gang-scheduling/order bug — maybe the admission-window comparator is nondeterministic. can you dump the queue ordering?

anna: pasted sample:
```
QUEUE_DUMP:
0: job_1423 (gang_size=4) state=WAITING priority=100 submit=1832099950
1: job_1424 (gang_size=1) state=WAITING priority=90 submit=1832099955
2: job_1425 (gang_size=1) state=RUNNABLE priority=95 submit=1832099960
3: job_1426 (gang_size=2) state=WAITING priority=80 submit=1832099970
```

sarah: we saw a similar flip in stage after PR #298 — jasper, did that change touch admission comparator logic?

jasper: yes, PR switched comparator to use a 'score' float for tie-breaks; i may have introduced instability when scores are NaN/inf. investigating now.

mike: mitigation idea: shrink admissionWindow to 1 to avoid HOL blocking, and enable best-effort fallback for gang jobs until we ship a fix.

anna: applying mitigation: `kubectl patch config scheduler --patch '{"spec":{"admissionWindow":1}}'` rolling now.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for scheduler-config in cluster-us-west — scheduler pods will restart.

anna: rollout finished — queue length dropped and GPU utilization rebalanced. tail latency back to baseline.

jasper: i'll revert the comparator change and add a deterministic tiebreaker (stable compare by job-id). i'll write unit tests for NaN/inf cases.

sarah: assigning action items: @jasper add tests + revert PR, @mike run a 2h soak in us-west, @anna capture cost delta and add to ticket.

mike: running soak now, will post metrics to #incidents if anything regresses.

anna: cost note: observed ~18% higher GPU tail time during the 30m spike, rough incremental cost $3.1k for 2h. adding to ticket and cost tracker.

jasper: PR 334 opened: "fix: deterministic admission comparator + tests" — requesting review from eng-infra.

sarah: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. we'll keep this thread for updates and put the postmortem on the eng board.
